 Our Denis Shapovalov vs Karen Khachanov Prediction
 Key Stats: Denis Shapovalov is winning 83 percent of his first-serve points against Karen Khachanov in their head-to-head series.
 Betting Analysis: It’s hard to pick a clear winner from this particular match because it has been over 5 years since the two faced each other. However, Shapovalov appears to enjoy a tactical edge in indoor conditions because he can generate massive serves. Again, Shapovalov has only conceded 5 service breaks to Khachanov in their head-to-head rivalry, which is a testament to how good a server the Canadian is. It’s going to be a competitive match, though Shapovalov’s ability to rack up free points will tip the balance of power in his favor.
